subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: What upgrade contract should apply when an existing DeepInfra configuration explicitly sets `nativeBaseUrl` to a native `/v1/inference` gateway?
rationale: The PR cannot safely infer that an arbitrary custom native gateway also exposes the OpenAI-compatible videos API, while removing or reinterpreting the shipped setting is a compatibility decision rather than a routine implementation detail.

options.title: Preserve Native Semantics
options.body: Keep the native request path whenever `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured, while using the new OpenAI videos path for default and `baseUrl` configurations.

options.title: Migrate Explicitly
options.body: Deprecate `nativeBaseUrl` through a plugin-owned doctor migration or clear startup error that requires the operator to provide a verified OpenAI-compatible URL.

options.title: Accept The Break
options.body: Intentionally reinterpret `nativeBaseUrl` as an OpenAI base and document that custom native-only gateways stop working after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Preserve Native Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the native request path whenever `nativeBaseUrl` is explicitly configured, while using the new OpenAI videos path for default and `baseUrl` configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent explicit reviewer signal makes this the best available owner for the shipped compatibility decision, with `ats3v` providing the strongest DeepInfra implementation context.
